Based on the retrieved excerpts, the ISO 45001 sub-clause that requires you to ensure outsourced functions and processes stay controlled is **clause 8.1.4.3**.

This clause states: "The organization must ensure that outsourced functions and processes are controlled: outsourcing arrangements must be consistent with legal requirements and other requirements and with achieving the intended outcomes of the OH&S system, and **the type and degree of control to be applied to these functions and processes must be defined within the OH&S management system**."

Since you are outsourcing your entire janitorial and facilities-upkeep function, this clause specifically applies to your situation and requires you to define and implement the appropriate type and degree of control for this outsourced function within your OH&S management system.
